subject: Sponsorship one-pager + case study for EdgeScale booth
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventorg.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <james@edgescale.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:15:00Z
Subject: EdgeScale sponsorship assets for June summit

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as a sponsor for the Summit on July 21. The marketing team asked if you could provide a one-page sponsor brief and a short customer case study we can feature on the partner page and in the event guide. Key asks:

- One-pager (2-sided PDF or single long PDF) summarizing Redwood inference offering + suggested booth talking points
- Short (300-450 words) customer case study highlighting a latency/cost win with a customer (sanitized if needed)
- A 2–3 minute demo script we can run on the booth screen (optional)

Attached: EdgeScale-brand-guidelines.pdf for logo usage and sponsor placement. Can you send drafts by next Monday (June 15)? Our creative team needs time to lock the guide.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Samantha
Partnerships Manager
Summit Organizing Co.

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventorg.com>
Cc: James Park <james@edgescale.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: EdgeScale sponsorship assets for June summit

Hi Samantha — thanks for the specs and the brand pack.

Summary: attaching first drafts for the one-pager and a case-study draft. Also pulled a booth demo script (v3) for internal review — if that looks good we can hand off the script to your AV team for playback.

Attachments: Redwood-EdgeScale-OnePager_v1.pdf; EdgeScale-case-study-draft.docx; Booth-demo-script_v3.md

Quick notes:
- One-pager focuses on production inference benefits (latency SLOs, cost/unit reductions, routing/fallbacks) with a short customer quote placeholder.
- Case study uses a redacted customer ("Acme Retail") to call out a 3x throughput improvement and 40% cost per transaction reduction after moving to Redwood Dedicated + batching + KV cache.
- Demo script highlights the live latency dashboard and a 90s scripted walkthrough of a model failover (shows graceful degradation).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Marissa: marketing copy + design polish
2) Dev: quick tech accuracy pass on numbers and demo steps
3) Grace: finalize and send to Samantha by EOD Monday (June 15)

If you prefer a shorter case study, we can trim to 300 words.

Thanks — GRACE
Grace O'Connor
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventorg.com>, James Park <james@edgescale.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: EdgeScale sponsorship assets for June summit

Nice work, Grace. Quick content edits from the marketing side:

- One-pager: tighten headline to "Predictable, Production-Grade LLM Inference". Shift the first bullet to a customer-centric benefit ("Reduce per-request cost by up to 40%—realized in production").
- Callouts: add a small diagram or icon row for "Latency", "Cost", "Reliability" — will request from design.
- Case study: swap the placeholder quote to something punchier: "Redwood cut our inference spend and made responses faster for customers" — attribute as "VP Engineering, Acme Retail" unless legal says otherwise.
- Tone: make the script less engineering-heavy for the booth crowd — more outcome-forward and demo moments rather than internals.

One thing: confirm the 3x throughput number with Dev — we should avoid hard claims without verification.

I can produce a layout mock by Friday if design capacity is free.

— Marissa
Director, Demand Gen
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@eventorg.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: EdgeScale sponsorship assets for June summit

Marissa — confirming numbers and a few technical clarifications:

- Throughput: 3x was a peak-case with batching + Dedicated; a conservative public-friendly stat is "up to 2.5x throughput" depending on payloads. Recommend we use "up to 2.5x" in collateral.
- Cost: 40% is plausible after quantization + batching for this workload; I can add a short footnote in the case study: "results based on a January 2026 Acme Retail pilot; actuals may vary."
- Demo script (Booth-demo-script_v3.md): removed a deep-dive on kernel selection, replaced with a single-line: "Switch model variant -> observe negligible latency change; fallback to small-model preserves responsiveness."

Also added two suggested bullets for booth talking points:
- "How we keep latency predictable even under burst traffic"
- "Typical time-to-value: 2–4 weeks from integration to steady-state"

If legal wants customer approval for the quote, let's flag that early — otherwise we'll use a redacted attribute.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
